scope: CSubtitle effect slots and lifetime, Banner/Scroll column parser, and fade/fad/move/org/pos effect construction in safe Rust; native rendering consumes detached values.

operations.behavior: Five typed optional owned values contain8params and4times. Queries copy values. Clear discards all slots. No raw Effect allocation/deletion or persistent native effect array remains on the experimental path. CClipper retains a transitional value copy.

Leading/trailing whitespace traverses stored rawcodeunits with iswspace. Empty/firstNUL inputs return. FindChar searches stored length including embeddedNUL; delimiter is included in effect name. CompareNoCase uses firstNUL CRT semantics. Scanf sees the original terminated suffix, not the right-trimmed span. Banner requires1assigned value; Scroll requires3; optional values startzero.

Delay applies exact ordered division and C++ max comparison; NaN selects1. Scroll swaps integer top/bottom before scaling. Scale multiplication/order and MSVC float-to-i32 indefinite values are preserved. Direction derives from stored name length12. Banner setswrap2 andmaxhard0; Scroll setshard2. Columns replace existing same-type slots.

Fade/fad share behavior selected byparametercount2or7; animated is set even on refusal. Move accepts4or6; Org/Pos accept2. Existing slot prevents CRT calls; first wins, including Move/Pos sharing one slot. Native generic hard-position dispatch remains upstream of this call. Params usewcstol/wcstod and exactscaleaxis/order. Fad times0/3=-1, Move defaulttimes=-1, Pos times0. All unused fields initializedzero.

Existing checked registry stores effect state and a nonwrapping revision. Each parser call clones state under short admission, runs CRT with no registry loan/native gate, then commits only if revision is unchanged. Reentrant clear/mutation refuses stale commit. Wrong/stale IDs cannot dereference native pointers; destruction removes resource under guard then drops it after guard release.

Bounded owned terminated UTF16. Fixed3/4%d formats with four valid distincti32 output slots use system swscanf via static legacy_stdio_definitions library; no custom numeric lexer. wcstod and wcstol preserve Windows locale/errno behavior. All numeric results copied byvalue.

limits: Experimental renderer/document-owner path only. No production switch or whole-renderer, host or library completion claim.
Windows CRT iswspace, _wcsicmp, swscanf, wcstol and wcstod remain audited system services. The final implementation still requires migration of other native parser/renderer/host/vendor code.

Native CSubtitle lifetime, style/parameter/value marshaling, caller buffer validity and shared-gate callback validity remain transitional FFI contracts. No Rust resource pointer or buffer borrow escapes.

Finite initialized Unicode Windows MSVC14.44 x86/x64 evidence. Allocation failure, new-handler reentry, signal/exception injection, arbitrary concurrent destruction and locale changes are not closed. Busy and internal failures remain experimental statuses, not established public host compatibility.

ASS-created native Effect::type is uninitialized and not read by the renderer for slots0/1/2. The probe deliberately omits that field; the Rust representation uses typed slot identity. No undefined native bytes are compared or reproduced.
Repeated Banner/Scroll assignment overwrites and leaks the old C++ allocation in the reference. Rust replaces the owned value safely; visible slot state is preserved, the leak is not reproduced.
Unsafe lexical counts are inventory, not a soundness proof or migration percentage. Crashes/hangs/nondeterminism remain unresolved; prior evidence retains its original provenance.
